en.headline: Sheung Shui Swimming Pool temporarily closed after vomit found
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department closed the North District pool for cleaning and superchlorination; it is scheduled to reopen at 8.55pm.
body: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department announced on Saturday that Sheung Shui Swimming Pool in the North District has been temporarily closed after a small amount of vomit was discovered in the pool.
The facility is undergoing cleaning and superchlorination. It is expected to reopen at 8.55pm the same day.
The department appealed to swimmers to be considerate and keep pools clean. It advised against swimming after a full meal and recommended using toilet facilities before entering the water.

zh.headline: 上水游泳池發現嘔吐物暫時關閉 今晚約9時重開
zh.dek: 康文署因池內發現少量嘔吐物進行清潔及超氯化處理，北區上水游泳池暫閉，預計晚上8時55分重開。
body: 康樂及文化事務署周六公布，北區上水游泳池因發現少量嘔吐物而暫時關閉，以進行清潔及超氯化處理。
泳池預計於今日晚上8時55分重開。
康文署呼籲泳客保持泳池清潔，用餐後不宜即時游泳，如有需要應先使用洗手間設施。
